lane: Mobile: Lô 4 of the Bầu trời hôm nay / Bản đồ số / Tôi là ai plan (Tôi là ai screen inside Profile)
goal: Do Lô 4 from docs/proposals/ASTRO_NUMEROLOGY_IMPLEMENTATION_2026-11-23.vi.md section 7 and 8: a 'Tôi là ai' section opened by tapping the name card on the Tôi tab, with an identity card (name, birth date/time/place when present, Sun/Moon/Rising chips from the saved own chart, hidden when unknown or ambiguous, numerology chip slot left for Lô 3), 'Bạn trong một câu' composed only from the Owner-approved astrology-big3 templates with the source of each clause, 'Nilaza đã ghi lại' showing counts only from 5 journal entries (hint below 5), saved reports (saved charts on this device) with Xem and Xóa (confirm first), 'Dữ liệu của tôi' (edit birth details and name, export, delete birth details) with an honest on-device / account-sync statement, and 'Hai hệ cùng nhìn bạn' marked 'Sắp có'.
successCriteria: Tapping the name card on the Tôi tab opens 'Tôi là ai'; Back returns to the Tôi tab.
Chips show only signs that are certain (one possible sign); Rising only with an exact birth time; no chip and an invite to make a chart when no chart is saved.
'Bạn trong một câu' uses sunHeadline + moonClause from astrology-big3.json (status approved), lists where each clause comes from, and is hidden unless Sun and Moon are both certain.

'Nilaza đã ghi lại' shows journal entries, saved readings and consecutive weeks with a journal entry only when there are 5 or more journal entries; below 5 it shows the 'Viết thêm vài mục…' hint with how many are left.
Consecutive-week count is a pure tested function (Monday-start local weeks, current or previous week may start the run, gaps break it).

Saved charts list shows each chart with Xem (opens that chart in Chiêm tinh) and Xóa (confirmation dialog, then removes it on this device and asks the account to delete its synced AI report when signed in, the same as the Chiêm tinh delete).

'Dữ liệu của tôi' rows open the birth and identity sections, export and delete birth details through the existing confirmation dialogs; the text tells the truth about sync (profile and birth details sync with the account when signed in; saved charts stay on this device).
No new data is sent anywhere; works offline and for guests.
tsc, mobile jest suite, mobile:check and validate:data pass.
untouchedSurfaces: No numerology calculation, no birth-name field, no life-path chip value (Lô 3); the identity card accepts an optional life-path label for Lô 3 to fill.
Profile row 'Ngày sinh & lá số' keeps its label until the name field exists (Lô 3).
No face-reading report storage exists in the app, so the saved-reports list covers saved charts only.
'Hai hệ cùng nhìn bạn' is a 'Sắp có' label only, no AI call.
No backend, SQL, Edge Function, Admin, prompt or store setting change; existing deleteAstrologyAiReportForChart client call is reused unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Tôi tab name card -> 'Tôi là ai' profile section; Xem on a saved chart -> Chiêm tinh opened on that chart; Back returns to the Tôi tab overview.
impact.dataWrite: Reads nilaza.astrology.v2 (saved charts) and journal entries already in memory. Xóa removes one chart and its notes from nilaza.astrology.v2, like the Chiêm tinh delete. No new storage key.
impact.backendContract: None changed. When signed in, Xóa calls the existing deleteAstrologyAiReportForChart before removing the local chart (same order as Chiêm tinh).
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin field or metric; mobile UI only.
impact.privacySafety: Birth data stays where it is today. The screen states that profile and birth details sync with the account when signed in, and that charts are saved on this device. Delete actions ask for confirmation.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; no data migration.
